name: gchat-approval-card
description: M19 U4 acceptance (X-rider W2): neither gchat nor matrix overrode the trait deliver_card, so M18 approval/ritual cards degraded to plain text on both. U4 gave gchat a native Cards-v2 deliver_card (and matrix an HTML formatted_body one). This fixture drives a send_card through the pipeline to gchat and, with model_rich_cards modelling gchat's card-capable contract, asserts the card reaches the channel as a STRUCTURED card (content.card with its buttons intact) rather than a flattened prose blob. The gchat Cards-v2 wire rendering itself is proven in the gchat adapter's own unit tests. See README.md.
